Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Sell smarter. Buy smarter. Learn your trading style.
Description: One FFXIV Market Board suite containing Should I Sell?, Should I Buy?, and Should I Tycoon?: selling guidance, budget-aware opportunity scanning, vendor and stack arbitrage analysis, confirmed purchase cost-basis capture, personal sales history, and trader performance analytics.
Changelog: v1.1.7 improves high-ticket Buy discovery: tiny extreme-ROI anomalies no longer monopolize the detailed shortlist; high absolute-gil gaps receive reserved analysis capacity; rare items may use conservative DC/region aggregates for discovery only, while final recommendations remain current-world and must pass the existing risk gates. The Buy UI now also exposes the effective per-item acquisition cap and gear-exclusion warning.
